title: MASEMiner
tagline: Extract TAS-20 factor loadings, inter-factor correlations, and coded study metadata for Meta-Analytic Structural Equation Modeling
description: Tailored workflow for MASEM extraction from TAS-20 (Toronto Alexithymia Scale, 20-item) studies. Pre-loaded with a vetted, multi-prompt-derived extraction template that produces, for every reported sample: (a) item-level standardised factor loadings F1.1–F5.20, (b) inter-factor correlations R1.2–R4.5 (10 unique pairs), and (c) study + sample metadata coded to a fixed scheme (pubtype, clinical, cfa, met, rot as integers; country / lang / age / sex / n) suitable for downstream meta-analytic database use.
task_description: Extract TAS-20 (2003) factor-analytic data: item-level factor loadings (F1.1–F5.20), inter-factor correlations (R1.2–R4.5), and study/sample metadata (pubyear, country, continent, lang, pubtype, n, sex, age, clinical, res, nfac, cfa, met, rot) for every sample reported in the paper.
context: Papers report TAS-20 psychometric / factor-analytic studies. Standard three-factor structure: F1 = DIF, F2 = DDF, F3 = EOT. Output uses flat dotted keys (F1.1, R1.2) so the viewer auto-renders them as tables. Coded metadata fields use the fixed integer schemes specified in the prompt (e.g. cfa: 0=EFA, 1=CFA; rot: 1=orthogonal, 2=oblique).
